## Names

<a id="text_font"></a>
### [`text_font`](../../../src/text_font.asm#L9) `$8800-$88FF`

*variable*

Charset of the title text and the status line (D018 = $32), built by cold_start (copy of the character ROM); the image bytes do not matter. Codes $00-$1F = ROM characters $20-$3F (space, punctuation, digits), $20-$3F = ROM $00-$1F (@, A-Z), $40-$5F and $60-$7F = the same two groups inverted. So code = ASCII - $20 for digits and capitals.

- **Written by:** [`cold_start`](cold_start.md#cold_start) [`$0457`](../../../src/cold_start.asm#L83), [`cold_start`](cold_start.md#cold_start) [`$0457`](../../../src/cold_start.asm#L83) (+1)

<a id="text_font_letters"></a>
### [`text_font_letters`](../../../src/text_font.asm#L15) `$8900-$89FF`

*variable*

Codes $20-$3F (ROM @, A-Z, [, pound, ], arrows). cold_start and reset_play_state fill code $20 with $FF (solid block in place of @).
